cmsBlocks.content: BDSisters operates on four foundational Islamic principles that preserve dignity, safety, and mutual support across our community.

principles.name: Amanah (Trust)
principles.desc: Safeguarding sister privacy, data integrity, and ethical business dealings.

principles.name: Ukhuwwah (Sisterhood)
principles.desc: Unconditional empathy, non-judgmental encouragement, and sincere solidarity.

principles.name: Ihsan (Excellence)
principles.desc: Striving for spiritual, intellectual, and professional excellence in every endeavor.

principles.name: Nasiha (Sincere Counsel)
principles.desc: Offering gentle guidance, constructive feedback, and mutual mentorship.

forumPosts.content:
How to maintain spiritual consistency in busy seasons of motherhood and business?

As sisters managing both household responsibilities and entrepreneurial projects, spiritual burnout can subtly creep in. In this reflection, I want to discuss small, micro-habits of Dhikr and Quran recitation that transformed my day. What routines work best for your morning Barakah hours?

Practical approaches to screen-free early childhood routines in Bangladesh.

Assalamu Alaikum sisters. Living in urban apartments makes physical play challenging. Here is how our homeschooling circle created rotating sensory bins and indoor active play corners with local, inexpensive materials. Would love to swap ideas on Montessori-aligned Bangla learning activities!

Pricing your artisanal products without compromising MRP or sisterhood fairness.

Many of us struggle with under-pricing our handmade goods out of shyness. Let us talk about cost-of-goods-sold (COGS), labor calculation, and how BDSisters platform rules ensure our MRP stays competitive while honoring our labor and dignity.

Offering: Graphic Design & Branding Kit | Seeking: Spoken Arabic Conversation Practice.

Bismillah. I have 6 years of experience in Figma, Canva Pro, and packaging design. I would love to design brand identity assets for a sister in exchange for weekly Conversational Modern Standard Arabic practice.
